faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MPSC Assistant Language Director recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the MPSC Assistant Language Director (Translation and Terminology) posts is 29th September 2026. Ensure all details are submitted accurately before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Degree or Master’s degree in Marathi (second class), English or Communication Skills in English, and Sanskrit qualification, along with 3 years of experience in administrative translation work.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to this position?
faq.answer: The age limit varies by category: UR candidates are 18-43 years, OBC/SC/ST/EWS/Anath are 18-48 years, Ex-Servicemen are 18-45 years, and Disabled candidates are 18-45 years.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Language Director post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Assistant Language Director (Translation and Terminology) position announced by MPSC.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for this role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary in the pay scale of ₹ 41,800 to ₹ 1,32,300 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for OBC/EWS/Anath/Divyang candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for candidates belonging to OBC/EWS/Anath/Divyang categories is ₹ 449.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for MPSC Assistant Language Director recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes an Online Application, followed by a Written Examination, and finally Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the MPSC Assistant Language Director position?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official MPSC website or the provided apply link before the last date of 29th September 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided for OBC/SC/ST/EWS/Anath candidates (18-48 years) and Ex-Servicemen/Disabled candidates (18-45 years).

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section on this page or by visiting the official MPSC website.
